scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --cwd server dev" "bun run --cwd client dev"
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:routes: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --grep @routes --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:e2e:professor: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --grep @professor --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:e2e:student: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --grep @student --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:e2e:integration: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --grep @integration --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:e2e:headed: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --headed --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --ui
scripts.test:e2e:debug: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --debug --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:record: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:record:headed: bun run test:e2e:install && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts --headed --project=chromium
